objective: Auditar en solo lectura la frescura de la base SoftRestaurant canónica de CIENFUEGOS y localizar posibles tablas históricas o de respaldo con cierres posteriores al 18 de octubre de 2026. No modificar datos ni código.
acceptance: Mostrar DB_NAME, MAX turnos.apertura, MAX cheques.fecha, MAX cheques.cierre, filas y MAX fecha de tempcheques
Inventariar tablas relacionadas con cheques, turnos, ventas, históricos o respaldos
Mostrar columnas temporales y de folio de las tablas candidatas
No ejecutar consultas dinámicas sobre tablas desconocidas
Cero DDL, cero DML y production_touched=false
constraints: No tocar los sincronizadores de Ventas del dia o Ventas cerradas
Mantener enfoque atomico, canonico y transversal
Trabajar solo en Desarrollo y no tocar Produccion

queries.name: cienfuegos_pos_freshness
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,(SELECT MAX(apertura) FROM turnos WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_turno_apertura,(SELECT MAX(fecha) FROM cheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_cheque_fecha,(SELECT MAX(cierre) FROM cheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_cheque_cierre,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM tempcheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS tempcheques_rows,(SELECT MAX(fecha) FROM tempcheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_tempcheque_fecha;

queries.name: cienfuegos_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%cheque%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%turno%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%venta%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%histor%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%respal%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME;

queries.name: cienfuegos_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%cheque%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%turno%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%venta%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%histor%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%respal%') AND (LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%fecha%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%cierre%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%apertura%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%folio%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%total%' OR LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%cheque%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION;
